subject: Pilot onramp: Nimbus Health — goals, access plan, and kickoff owners
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir@nimhealth.com>, Priya Agarwal <priya.agarwal@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot onramp: Nimbus Health — goals, access plan, and kickoff owners

Hi Samir / Priya — great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to get the pilot (30-day POC) moving. This is focused on your clinical triage assistant use case: intent classification + structured summary generation for nurse intake.

Top pain points you called out:
- High false positives on intent detection (~28%) leading to manual routing backlog
- Slow turnaround on post-call summaries (avg 12–18 mins) that delays triage
- Tight data residency / access restrictions for PHI-containing call logs

Pilot goals (success criteria) — what we agreed:
1) Intent accuracy improvement: reduce false positive rate by >= 12 percentage points on the evaluation prompt set
2) Summary latency: median summary generation < 4s per request at your expected concurrency (10 rps)
3) Safety & privacy: no retained PHI in logs (we'll run a redaction preprocessor and S3 encapsulation)

Scope and rough plan (30 days):
- Week 0 (this week): access & environment setup (see attached access checklist)
- Week 1: ingest 5k de-identified transcripts, baseline evals with our prompt seed
- Week 2: tuning and prompt-eval iterations + quantized model candidate tests
- Week 3: load/latency benchmarking in your staging VPC; roll canary to limited live traffic if agreed
- Week 4: final acceptance run + handoff and ops runbook

Owners we discussed:
- Nimbus: Samir (product lead) + Priya (security/compliance) + Procurement for MOU
- Redwood: me (program lead), Ben Carter (platform integration), Marissa Cole (prompt/eval lead)

Access asks (short list) — items we need to start:
- S3 bucket with staging transcripts (de-identified) and a service account/key with read access
- Temporary VPN or AWS VPC peering details for Redwood staging nodes
- PO/Procurement contact for MOU/statement of work (I included procurement@nimhealth.com in cc)

Attachments I’m sending with this email: access checklist, initial prompt eval seed, our standard MOU template (redlines expected). Please confirm if your legal team needs any custom clauses for data residency.

Next actions (please reply with):
- Confirm who will provision the S3/service account (name + email)
- A preferred date/time for a 30-min kickoff ops call (I’m proposing Thu 2/11 or Mon 2/15, 10–11am PT)
- Any immediate blocker we missed on the call

Thanks — excited to get started.

—
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

[attachments: nimbus_access_checklist.pdf, prompt_evals_seed.csv, mou_template_redwood_v1.docx]

Thanks Olga — really helpful summary and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Procurement & MOU: procurement@nimhealth.com will kick off the review today. Expect questions on the data handling exhibits; I flagged that Priya will be the SME.
2) S3 access: I can create the bucket and grant a read-only role to redwood-staging@nimhealth (please confirm the exact service account/email you want us to use). ETA for bucket + sample dataset: EOD Thursday (2/11).
3) Kickoff call: Thu 2/11 10:00am PT works for Samir, Priya; I put a placeholder on the calendar. If Redwood needs Mon 2/15 instead, let me know.

One ask: can Redwood share a one-page runbook for how you handle PHI-stripped data during the pilot (storage TTL, deletion workflow)? Priya wants that for the compliance packet.

Samir
Head of Product, Nimbus Health
samir@nimhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2222

Thanks Samir — perfect. Quick responses and what we’ll attach for Priya’s compliance packet: 

- One-page runbook (attached PDF) describing our ingestion → redaction → ephemeral cache → deletion flow, TTL defaults, and audit log locations.
- Scoped SOC2 excerpt that outlines our handling of customer-provided data during trials (non-production controls).
- Confirmation that Redwood can operate in your VPC (we’ll supply exact service account name by EOD).

Service account to request read access for: redwood-olga-staging@redwood-pilot. We’ll actually use temporary STS tokens rather than long lived keys — we’ll document the flow in the runbook.

I’ve updated the HubSpot deal with the kickoff placeholder and uploaded the access checklist + prompt seed to the Drive link above. MOU: if procurement wants to use their standard PO instead of our template that’s fine — we just need a short SOW (1 page) signed that references DEAL-43821.

Next steps we own for the immediate kickoff: 
- Redwood (Olga/Ben): share runbook + service account details by EOD 2/10
- Nimbus (Samir/Priya): create S3 bucket + grant read-only role by EOD 2/11
- Schedule: Ops kickoff Thu 2/11 10am PT (calendar invite pending)

If anyone prefers a separate security deep-dive ahead of Thurs, we can run a 30-min session with our security SME — say Wed 2/10 11am PT. Samir / Priya, let me know if you want to add that.

—
Olga
